nonBlockingObservations.title: Remove the superseded closed-pipe proof sentence
nonBlockingObservations.detail: LD-D1A-2 still says a SIGPIPE-free closed-pipe write demonstrates F_SETNOSIGPIPE. The r2 change table explicitly withdraws that argument and requires F_GETNOSIGPIPE plus an omission mutant, so the effective requirement is clear. Remove or label the old sentence as superseded when publishing to avoid confusing implementers.
